title: Miscarriage: Expectant, Medical and Surgical Management

evidenceAudit.scope: Woman with confirmed early miscarriage choosing expectant, medical or surgical management: mifepristone and misoprostol doses, anti-D immunoglobulin after surgery and follow-up testing, using NICE NG126.
findings: Every dose, threshold and timing was checked against the cited source section on 2026-10-18.
Normal values are typical adult reference ranges; laboratories differ.
unverifiedSections: The route of misoprostol in each recommendation, the repeat-dose rules, and the surgical technique recommendations were not fully captured from NICE NG126.
Analgesia and antiemetic advice were not captured.
No Saudi guideline was opened. Local gestational-age limits for medical management were not checked.
Source pages were read through automated page extraction rather than page-by-page in the original documents, so each figure should be spot-checked against the source during clinical review.
The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) drug registration site could not be opened from this environment, so registration of each medicine was not verified; check hospital formulary.

pathophysiology.summary: For bleeding under 6 weeks without pain, NICE advises expectant management and a repeat pregnancy test after 7 to 10 days. Medical management for missed miscarriage is mifepristone 200 mg orally followed 48 hours later by misoprostol 800 micrograms. For incomplete miscarriage, misoprostol 600 micrograms is offered without mifepristone; 800 micrograms is acceptable. Anti-D immunoglobulin 250 IU is given only after surgical management in Rhesus D negative women; a Kleihauer test is not needed. A negative home urine pregnancy test at 3 weeks confirms that the miscarriage is complete.

clinicalManagement.title: Offer the choice
actions: Offer expectant management first; offer medical or surgical management by preference and circumstance.

clinicalManagement.title: Expectant management
actions: Advise on bleeding and return; repeat urine test at 7 to 10 days if bleeding under 6 weeks without pain.

clinicalManagement.title: Medical management
actions: Missed miscarriage: mifepristone 200 mg orally then misoprostol 800 micrograms 48 hours later.
Incomplete miscarriage: misoprostol 600 micrograms; no mifepristone.

clinicalManagement.title: Surgical management and anti-D
actions: Give anti-D 250 IU to Rhesus D negative women after surgery only; no Kleihauer test.

clinicalManagement.title: Confirm completion
actions: Advise a home urine pregnancy test at 3 weeks; arrange review if positive.
